description: Discover and triage hardware debug interfaces (UART, JTAG, SWD) on an authorized embedded device — read boot logs, land a root console, interrupt the bootloader, and extract flash for offline analysis. Load when handed a physical device, PCB, or IoT/embedded target in scope, exposed test points or header pins, a serial console, U-Boot prompt, or a flash chip to dump. Signals: TX/RX/GND pads, silkscreen labels, baud-rate guessing, IDCODE enumeration.
